resume.title: 聂何简历

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: The Honorable Ho Nieh was designated as the Chairman of the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission by U.S. President Donald Trump on January 8, 2026. Chairman Nieh had previously been sworn in as an NRC Commissioner on December 4, 2025 for a term ending June 30, 2029.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: He is the first former NRC resident inspector to serve as a Commissioner.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: Immediately prior to this appointment, Chairman Nieh served as an officer of Southern Nuclear on loan to the Institute of Nuclear Power Operations (INPO). He joined Southern Nuclear in March 2021 to assume the role of Vice President of Regulatory Affairs after more than 20 years as an NRC staff member.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: His other roles at the NRC included: Senior Resident Inspector; Director of the Division Reactor Projects in Region 1, in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania; Director of Division Inspection and Regional Support at NRC headquarters; and Chief of Staff for Commissioner William Ostendorff.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: He also served as Communications Advisor to the International Atomic Energy Agency and worked at Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory as a civilian instructor for the Navy’s Nuclear Power Program.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: Chairman Nieh earned his Bachelor of Engineering in marine engineering from New York Maritime College and is a graduate of the United States Naval Nuclear Power School. He attended Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute for graduate studies in nuclear engineering and earned a Master of Business Administration from Johns Hopkins University.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: Chairman Nieh completed the Executive Education in Strategic Management program from the Harvard Kennedy School of Government.

sources.title: Nieh | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: While at the NRC, Chairman Nieh served as Director of the Office of Nuclear Reactor Regulation, where he was responsible for reactor safety licensing and oversight programs for operating and new reactors.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 26-005: Ho Nieh Named 20th NRC Chairman
sources.excerpt: Ho K. Nieh has been designated by U.S. President Donald J. Trump as the 20th Chairman of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, effective immediately. Nieh replaces David A. Wright, who the President named Chairman on Jan. 21, 2025, and who will continue to serve as a Commissioner.

sources.title: The Commission | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: Chairman Ho K. Nieh

sources.title: NRC Updates AP1000 Design Certification, Streamlines Future Reactor Licensing | Nuclear Regulatory Commission
sources.excerpt: “The NRC’s approval of the updated AP1000 design provides the regulatory foundation for America to move from building individual reactors to deploying them at scale,” Chairman Ho K. Nieh said.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 18-016: NRC Announces Senior Management Selections
sources.excerpt: Ho K. Nieh will become Director of NRR in August. Nieh, a member of the SES, will return to the NRC this summer from the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development, where he serves as the Director, Division of Nuclear Safety Technology and Regulation at the Nuclear Energy Agency.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 18-016: NRC Announces Senior Management Selections
sources.excerpt: He began his NRC career in 1997 as an engineer in Region I, joining the agency after serving in various engineering positions at the Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 18-016: NRC Announces Senior Management Selections
sources.excerpt: At the NRC, Nieh worked as a resident and senior resident inspector before joining the newly created Office of Nuclear Security and Incident Response in 2003.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 18-016: NRC Announces Senior Management Selections
sources.excerpt: He has also served in various management positions in NRR, including Director, Division of Inspection and Regional Support, and Director, Division of Reactor Projects. Additionally, Nieh was assigned to the International Atomic Energy Agency, Department of Nuclear Safety and Security, and also served as Chief of Staff to Commissioner Bill Ostendorff.

sources.title: NRC News Release No. 18-016: NRC Announces Senior Management Selections
sources.excerpt: He graduated from the U.S. Naval Nuclear Power School and holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Marine Engineering from the State University of New York Maritime College and a Master of Business Administration from Johns Hopkins University.

sources.title: Nuclear Energy Agency - Contacts - New senior appointment
sources.excerpt: Mr Ho Nieh has been appointed NEA Head of the Division of Nuclear Safety Regulation and Technology. He took up his duties on 31 August 2015.

sources.title: Nuclear Energy Agency - Contacts - New senior appointment
sources.excerpt: He began his career in operation, maintenance and training at a United States Navy nuclear power plant. Mr Nieh joined the United States Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) in 1997 as a resident inspector and conducted safety inspections at pressurised water and boiling water reactors.

sources.title: Nuclear Energy Agency - Contacts - New senior appointment
sources.excerpt: Prior to joining the NEA, Mr Nieh was the Director of the Division of Reactor Projects in the NRC Region 1 office where he was responsible for the resident inspectors assigned to 25 nuclear power plants.

sources.title: Nuclear Energy Agency - Contacts - New senior appointment
sources.excerpt: Mr Nieh, a United States national, holds a Bachelor's degree in Marine Engineering from the New York Maritime College.

sources.title: Nuclear Energy Agency - Contacts - New senior appointment
sources.excerpt: Mr Nieh has 22 years of experience in nuclear power plant safety regulation and policy.

sources.title: 42 U.S.C. 5841 — Nuclear Regulatory Commission (United States Code, 2023 Edition)
sources.excerpt: (1) There is established an independent regulatory commission to be known as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission which shall be composed of five members, each of whom shall be a citizen of the United States. The President shall designate one member of the Commission as Chairman thereof to serve as such during the pleasure of the President.

sources.title: PN445-6 — Ho Nieh — Nuclear Regulatory Commission, 119th Congress (2025-2026)
sources.excerpt: Ho Nieh, of Alabama, to be a Member of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission for the remainder of the term expiring June 30, 2029, vice Christopher T. Hanson.

sources.title: PN445-6 — Ho Nieh — Nuclear Regulatory Commission, 119th Congress (2025-2026)
sources.excerpt: Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 66 - 32. Record Vote Number: 620.
